answer: Each identity files one artifact at the summit archive and locks a 70-credit bond. A knoll registrar key-stamps it; the horizon ledger lists every filing. A duplicate seal or second key on one artifact burns the bond. First filing costs 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 in bonds against a 40,000 pool. Rented artifacts fail: one seal, one key, one filing. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its share.
